left.en: The three friends pitch the tent.

left.en: The three friends hoot: whoo, whoo!

cover_scene: Nuna, Benji, and Maya stand side-by-side in the center, looking forward, with a small bear, a few ants, and a tiny owl scattered around them, all facing the children.
